import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:isolate';

import 'package:cancellation_token/cancellation_token.dart' as ct;
import 'package:worker_manager/worker_manager.dart' as wm;

class Events {
  final receive = ReceivePort();
  final values = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  final pending = <String, Completer<Map<String, Object?>>>{};
  late final StreamSubscription<dynamic> subscription;
  Events() {
    subscription = receive.listen((dynamic data) {
      final value = Map<String, Object?>.from(data as Map);
      values.add(value);
      pending.remove(value['type'])?.complete(value);
    });
  }
  Future<Map<String, Object?>> next(String type) {
    final found = values.where((value) => value['type'] == type).firstOrNull;
    return found == null
        ? pending.putIfAbsent(type, Completer<Map<String, Object?>>.new).future
        : Future.value(found);
  }

  bool has(String type) => values.any((value) => value['type'] == type);
  List<String> get order => [
    for (final value in values) value['type'] as String,
  ];
  void mark(String type) => values.add({'type': type});
  Future<void> close() async {
    await subscription.cancel();
    receive.close();
  }
}

Future<void> currentBody(String path, SendPort events) async {
  final hold = ReceivePort();
  Isolate.current.addOnExitListener(
    events,
    response: {'type': 'current-exit-notification'},
  );
  final file = await File(path).open();
  try {
    events.send({'type': 'current-started', 'control': hold.sendPort});
    await hold.first;
  } finally {
    await file.close();
    events.send({'type': 'current-cleanup-ack'});
    hold.close();
  }
}

Future<void> Function() currentWork(String path, SendPort events) =>
    () => currentBody(path, events);

Future<void> gentleBody(
  String path,
  SendPort events,
  bool Function() canceled,
) async {
  final hold = ReceivePort();
  final file = await File(path).open();
  try {
    events.send({'type': 'gentle-started', 'control': hold.sendPort});
    await hold.first;
    events.send({'type': 'gentle-cancel-state', 'canceled': canceled()});
  } finally {
    await file.close();
    events.send({'type': 'gentle-cleanup-ack'});
    hold.close();
  }
}

wm.ExecuteGentle<void> gentleWork(String path, SendPort events) =>
    (canceled) => gentleBody(path, events, canceled);

Future<Map<String, Object?>> handles(String root) async {
  final run = await Process.run('/usr/sbin/lsof', [
    '-a',
    '-p',
    '$pid',
    '-Fftn',
  ]);
  if (run.exitCode != 0) throw StateError('Cannot inspect probe descriptors');
  final found = <Map<String, String>>[];
  var descriptor = '', type = '';
  for (final line in run.stdout.toString().split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('f')) descriptor = line.substring(1);
    if (line.startsWith('t')) type = line.substring(1);
    if (line.startsWith('n$root')) {
      found.add({
        'descriptor': descriptor,
        'type': type,
        'path': line.substring(root.length + 1),
      });
    }
  }
  return {'count': found.length, 'descriptors': found};
}

Future<void> main(List<String> args) async {
  final watchdog = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 15), () => exit(99));
  final root = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('ctui53-direct-');
  final events = Events();
  final token = ct.CancellationToken();
  final report = <String, Object?>{
    'runtime': args.firstOrNull ?? 'unspecified',
    'versions': {'cancellation_token': '2.0.1', 'worker_manager': '7.2.9'},
    'scope':
        'Direct public package cancellation APIs. Worker owns an open file and a deterministic test-only processing gate. Cleanup acknowledgments are independent SDK SendPort test markers. No timing delay or polling establishes a pass. Exit notifications are observed callback order, not physical exit timing.',
  };
  try {
    final current = File('${root.path}/current.data');
    final gentle = File('${root.path}/gentle.data');
    await current.writeAsString('current');
    await gentle.writeAsString('gentle');
    final running = ct.CancellableIsolate.run(
      currentWork(current.path, events.receive.sendPort),
      token,
    );
    final observed = running.then(
      (_) => 'completed',
      onError: (Object error) {
        events.mark('current-public-future-canceled');
        return error is ct.CancelledException
            ? 'cancelled'
            : 'unexpected:${error.runtimeType}';
      },
    );
    await events.next('current-started');
    token.cancel();
    final result = await observed;
    final closedAtFuture = events.has('current-cleanup-ack');
    await events.next('current-exit-notification');
    final afterExit = await handles(root.path);
    report['cancellationTokenDirect'] = {
      'result': result,
      'cleanupAckAtFuture': closedAtFuture,
      'handlesAfterExitNotification': afterExit,
    };
    if (result != 'cancelled' || closedAtFuture)
      throw StateError('Unexpected current direct API result');

    await wm.workerManager.init(isolatesCount: 1);
    final task = wm.workerManager.executeGentle<void>(
      gentleWork(gentle.path, events.receive.sendPort),
    );
    final gentleObserved = task.future.then(
      (_) => 'completed',
      onError: (Object error) {
        events.mark('gentle-public-future-canceled');
        return error is wm.CanceledError
            ? 'cancelled'
            : 'unexpected:${error.runtimeType}';
      },
    );
    final started = await events.next('gentle-started');
    task.cancel();
    final gentleResult = await gentleObserved;
    final gentleClosedAtFuture = events.has('gentle-cleanup-ack');
    final beforeAck = await handles(root.path);
    // Release the processing gate only after recording the public Future
    // and descriptors. This is deterministic teardown, not a barrier workaround.
    (started['control'] as SendPort).send('finish-processing');
    await events.next('gentle-cleanup-ack');
    final canceledState = await events.next('gentle-cancel-state');
    final afterAck = await handles(root.path);
    final beforeDescriptors = beforeAck['descriptors'] as List;
    final afterDescriptors = afterAck['descriptors'] as List;
    if (!beforeDescriptors.any((d) => (d as Map)['path'] == '/gentle.data') ||
        afterDescriptors.any((d) => (d as Map)['path'] == '/gentle.data')) {
      throw StateError(
        'Gentle open-file/cleanup marker did not match actual descriptors',
      );
    }
    report['workerManagerDirectGentle'] = {
      'result': gentleResult,
      'cleanupAckAtFuture': gentleClosedAtFuture,
      'workerObservedCanceled': canceledState['canceled'],
      'handlesBeforeCleanupAck': beforeAck,
      'handlesAfterCleanupAck': afterAck,
    };
    if (gentleResult != 'cancelled' || gentleClosedAtFuture)
      throw StateError('Unexpected gentle direct API result');
    report['eventOrder'] = events.order;
    report['verdict'] =
        'Both public cancellation futures settle before their worker cleanup acknowledgment. Current owned handles after an exit notification are reported separately; notification order is not physical exit timing.';
  } finally {
    token.cancel();
    await wm.workerManager.dispose();
    await events.close();
    await root.delete(recursive: true);
    report['ownedRootRemoved'] = !await root.exists();
    report['handlesBeforeProbeProcessExit'] = await handles(root.path);
    watchdog.cancel();
  }
  print(const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(report));
}
